about_the_game:
In a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by nuclear bombs that have contaminated the planet, altering people's behavior completely, Max is a survivor.

In a dramatic and terrifying moment, Max manages to protect his wife from malicious individuals and begins an unrelenting search for his young daughter, who was kidnapped by a gang in this devastated world, which has a frightening behavior and way of living.

Max needs to survive in this environment, facing radiation, the heat of the day, the cold of the night, thirst, and hunger. With courage, he'll confront all obstacles and enemies in this new world, trying once again to find meaning in his survival, which is to protect those he loves.

With a characteristic progression of survival and RPG games, the player will gradually adjust Max's characteristics, increasing his skills and making choices that can change the course of the story.

Among the game's unique features, we can highlight:

  • Play in first or third person.

  • Experience an open world to explore numerous mysterious and perilous locations.

  • Forge alliances or make enemies on your journey, your choices make a difference.

  • Evolve your character throughout the story to face enemies and terrifying creatures.

  • Use guns and cars to achieve your objectives.

  • Manage resources for your survival and take care not to be killed by radiation.

Max Madness is your next survival, horror, drama, suspense, and adventure game. Dive into a world of madness, where survival is key.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 22H2 (10.0.19045)
  • Processor: Core i5-7500 or Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 with updates
  • Processor: Core i7-12700 or Ryzen 7 7800X3D
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required

short_description: Enter the world of Max Madness, a post-apocalyptic survival game with RPG and action elements. Navigate a treacherous open world, ravaged by nuclear devastation, where tension and terror lurk around every corner. Forge alliances, confront chaos, and make choices that shape your destiny.
